title: C05 App Router architecture

files_forbidden: all app/(challenges)/* directories not belonging to this task

acceptance_criteria: The challenge demonstrates a route group, a dynamic segment, and a catch-all segment, plus working loading.tsx, error.tsx (a Client Component), and not-found.tsx (reached via notFound()) — the error boundary is verifiably a Client Component (QA functional: rendering strategies / app-router segments resolve).
Parallel routes are used with an explicit @modal slot AND a default.tsx for that slot so unmatched states render cleanly without a 404.

An intercepting route gives a product quick-view modal-via-URL: clicking a product card on soft-nav opens the modal overlay with the URL updated and the listing still visible in the background (QA: intercepting-route modal opens via in-app soft navigation).
The same product URL deep-linked / hard-refreshed renders the full standalone product page, not the modal (QA: intercepting-route URL deep-links and refreshes to the full page, not the modal).

The c05 _meta folder contains spec.md (non-empty acceptance criteria), defend-it.md (3-5 from-memory questions with model answers), verification.md, and a discoverable challenge.config.ts; data is read via a local _lib helper over lib/data without editing lib/data.
output_format: code plus plain English explanation of every non-obvious decision
